_note: portal-case-list-declarations, design D3 and D4. portalBranch is the vestigingsnummer of the company branch a case was filed under; portaliq's branch scope reads it through mijnZaken.branchField, so a session restricted to one branch sees only that branch's cases. portalIdentityKind says how a resident may reach a case of this type in the portal; absent means account only. No case type is seeded with reference, because portaliq does not yet check the e-mail address against the case. portalParty (site-business-and-authorisation D2) names the party a case belongs to in portaliq's typed form, subject:<subjectRef> or kvk:<8 digits>, never a BSN; portaliq's mandate filter reads it through mijnZaken.mandateField.

portalBranch.title: Branch number
portalBranch.description: The branch number (vestigingsnummer) of the company that filed the case in the portal.

portalParty.title: Portal party
portalParty.description: Who the case belongs to in the portal: a person (subject:) or a company (kvk:).

portalIdentityKind.title: Ways in to the portal
portalIdentityKind.description: How an applicant may open a case of this type in the portal. Empty means with an account only.
